description: This file defines the EmployeeJobController class within the OrangeHRM system, responsible for managing employee job-related views and interactions, such as retrieving services for job titles, categories, company structure, employment status, and locations, and preparing data for rendering employee job details.

classes.name: EmployeeJobController
classes.description: Controller class managing employee job details view, including retrieving related services, preparing data properties, and handling permissions within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getJobTitleService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of JobTitleService.

methods.name: getJobCategoryService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of JobCategoryService.

methods.name: getCompanyStructureService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of CompanyStructureService.

methods.name: getEmploymentStatusService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of EmploymentStatusService.

methods.name: getLocationService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of LocationService.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the data and component for rendering employee job info based on the request's empNumber; sets properties such as job titles, categories, statuses, subunits, locations, and termination reasons, and manages permissions.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns an array of data groups required for permission checks, specifically 'job_details'.
